title: Storage of Spittlebugs or Leafhoppers
author: Niels Appelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8jfhujn

steps.title: Prepare Storage Container
steps.instruction: Prepare a PET container (e.g., 250ml white PET jar) for insect storage.

substeps.instruction: Cover the bottom of the container with moisturised single-use towels (wetted with tapwater and squeezed to remove excess water).
Provide airholes in the container using an (injection) needle.
Fill the container with suitable plants.

steps.title: Transfer Insects to Container
steps.instruction: Transfer insects from their temporary storage tube into the prepared PET container.

substeps.instruction: Invert the temporary storage tube and allow insects to climb up.
Hold the tube above the new storage container, unscrew the cap, and forcefully tap the back of the tube so the insects drop into the container.

steps.title: Seal Container
steps.instruction: Swiftly close the new storage container to minimize the time insects have to recover and escape.

steps.title: Move to Experimental Setup
steps.instruction: Move insects into experimental setups as soon as possible, preferably within 2 days.

substeps.instruction: Note that survival rate is highly variable, though up to 7 days of survival has been achieved.
